items.title: Mutually inverse isomorphisms between the group of k-cycles and K_0 of the truncated coherent category
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the group of k-cycles of a scheme locally of finite type over S with K_0 of the quotient of the coherent sheaves of dimension at most k by those of dimension at most k-1 through two explicit maps (statement lines 3756-3779, tag 02S9). One direction is a formal additive-function argument, but the other needs real work: the proof reduces an arbitrary coherent F by cutting out the part supported in dimension at most k-1, filters the stalks at the generic points of the components of [F]_k, glues the resulting kernels back into coherent subsheaves, and then replaces each graded piece by an ideal sheaf inside O_{Z_i} so that two comparison quotients land in Coh_{<=k-1}(X). This multi-step gluing goes well beyond a routine citation, so the claim is H2.
